summary: Hanko Startup Plan added to Sourcey as one entity and one offer; PR #1280 merged and the vendor record is live at https://sourcey.com/c/hanko.

observations.detail: PR #1280 was merged into sourcey/startup-credits on 2026-09-18T08:46:27Z by sourcey[bot]. Head commit b852abfc437e9bc8c323c2727fe1e9a219c1e704, merge commit 6b3be107. The pull request is authored by GitHub user codeboost-tr, the claimant's verified GitHub identity.

The merge adds exactly one file, entities/ha/hanko.yaml, holding one new entity (slug hanko, shard ha) and exactly one offer. No other file is touched, so the change is data-only. sha256 of the file at merge commit 6b3be107: 066ad0fe5ac5c876928ba0838c7c6c532c6812875b6eb97bad44f6ebdb90b35c.

The only cited source is https://www.hanko.io/startup-plan, a page on the vendor's own domain. Fetched at HTTP 200 on 2026-09-18 and it still states the offer: one million free monthly active users for the startup's Hanko Cloud organization (Free plan or Pro subscription), free consulting and setup support, and backlinks from Hanko's case study page, held for life or until the startup generates more than $500k ARR or receives more than $1M in VC funding. This is a startup-specific program, not a generic free tier or trial: the Hanko Cloud Free tier's MAU limit is raised to 1 million only under the Startup Plan, which is applied for and granted case by case.

All three checks are green on head b852abfc: sourcey/admission success ('Sourcey admission passed'), sourcey/validation success ('Sourcey Catalog validation success'), and 'validate catalog change' success. Every commit on the branch carries a DCO Signed-off-by line matching the commit author codeboost-tr <codeboost.tr@gmail.com>.

https://sourcey.com/c/hanko returns HTTP 200 and renders the company record: name Hanko, category 'Auth and security', domain www.hanko.io, '1 offer' titled 'Hanko Startup Plan', with provenance 'observed 18 Sept', entity revision sha256:01de679c2c3a... and offer revision sha256:84e89d170d04.... Publication therefore completed after the merge.

Sourcey's admission gate reported 'needs revision' twice before passing, and both findings were fixed on the same pull request rather than papered over: first claim_unsupported plus entity_summary_required (profile.summary added, consideration encoded as kind: none, benefits split one per source bullet, the free service named as Hanko Cloud), then claim_contradicted on the backlinks benefit (its description now quotes the cited sentence).
